note: Mechanical interface of the custom boards (build/15: three boards + the encoder daughterboard that STACK 5.8 requires to be replaceable). Board coordinates: origin at the lower-left corner of the board outline as seen from the component side; mm. place.origin = enclosure coordinates of that corner; place.z_bottom = z of the board face opposite the components; place.facing = direction the component side faces (+z towards the front face, -z towards the rear wall). Only the mechanical interface is defined here; routing, footprints and Gerbers belong to the PCB work (pcb/).

PWR.name: power board PWR-A, plate-bonded (PWR_MAIN + PWR_BRANCH + USB_POWER)

place.mount: plate front face; Gelid 0.5 mm pads under the thermal_bond zones, gap 0.4 mm set by shim washers (mechanical.json pwr_bond)

PWR.screw: the M3 male stud of the PWR-A/PWR-B standoff (F45, M3 male-female, body 5.0 = the B2B stack) from the component side (board 1.6 + shim 0.4 + plate 2.0: the stud is 3.53-4.0 long, so it fills the 1.53 thread of the PEM nut flush with the plate front face and its tip ends at most flush with the plate rear face, as the earlier M3 x 4 did; generated/fastener-stacks.json PWR_A-PLATE)
PWR._max_height_note: W2 MECH-3: hA 4.5 of pcb/partition-spec.json parameters (B2B mated stack 5.00 minus 0.5 clearance), the height under the PWR-B mezzanine; PWR-A parts taller than hA stand in PWR-B windows (window ceiling 12.1 = stack 5.0 + board 1.6 + hB 5.5) or in uncovered edge strips (headers); the windows other than the two Pololu ones are placed by PCB-PWRA (pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.a window_refs, 3.8k mm2 with the Pololu windows)

height_zones.why: PWR-B window over U107 D36V50F12 (module on its header spacer: parts.json pololu_d36v50 7.67 + mount_standoff 2.5 = 10.17); window ceiling 12.1 (pcb/partition-spec.json height_rule); rule R-PWR-MODULES
PWR-B window over U108 D36V50F5 (same module); window ceiling 12.1; rule R-PWR-MODULES

PWR._thermal_bond_note: placement contract for the PCB work: TPS7A4701 x2 and LT3045 x2 inside the two lower zones (their exposed pads stitched to bottom copper), D36V50F12 and D36V50F5 inside the two zones of the left leg; the Pololu modules are purchased carrier boards without an exposed pad that stand on their header spacer (1.8 mm bottom-side parts): their GND/VIN/VOUT pins conduct into a copper pour that is stitched to bottom copper; each zone gets one Gelid pad of the same size

modules_on_board._pin_field_note: placement contract (W2 MECH-3): footprint SR_RX_Custom:Pololu_D36V50Fx at rotation 0 with its two 6-pin rows (pads D1.7 at x -6.35..6.35, y 8.89 / 11.43 from the module centre) towards -y of the board; the plate relief pocket M-07 PK1 lies under this field
same contract as U107; plate relief pocket M-07 PK2

rear-layer harness through plate slot SL2: J206 SL2-PWR-MF (S13, S14, S17, S18; Micro-Fit) and the battery-path S06/S07 leads to the rear-wall INA228 / #2813 (W2 MECH-3 routes); S04, S20-S22 and S35 leave from PWR-B J204/J207 (build/16-dzhgut-rozyemy.csv, W2 GR-3)

tht_pockets.rule: every PWR-A THT pad group gets a relief pocket in the plate front face (M-07): pin field + margin on each side, depth >= depth_min, with a polyimide insulator over the pocket and the 0.4 mm shim gap (trimmed THT joints with a bottom fillet stand 0.3-1 mm proud and would pierce the 0.5 mm Gelid pad: pcb/partition-spec.json keepouts.pwr_a_tht_pockets)
tht_pockets.from_placement: the other PWR-A THT groups (radials, Keystone 3568 fuse holders, the PWR-A harness headers: pcb/partition-budget.json candidates.<chosen> pwr_a_tht_pocket_items, which also list U107/U108) are pocketed at the positions of the PCB-PWRA placement: OPEN until it exists (rule R-PWR-POCKETS prints the current count)
tht_pockets.insulator: polyimide film over each pocket and across the shim gap (product TBD: SRC-2 C-18 polyimide tape)

PWR.notes: Fastening (W2 MECH-3): the M3 male studs of the seven PWR-A/PWR-B standoffs F45 into PEM F-M3-1 self-clinching flush nuts in the plate (pressed flush with the plate front face, M-07; the 1.53 shank stops 0.47 short of the rear face and the stud tip at most flush with it, so nothing reaches the RF side; no cut thread in the plate, STACK 5.8); PWR-B sits on the standoffs (boards.json PWR_B, F46). D36V50F12 U107 and D36V50F5 U108 are soldered into the left leg (footprint SR_RX_Custom:Pololu_D36V50Fx) and stand in PWR-B windows. The IP2368 retail board sits on the plate in the HMI column (layout item ip2368). Area check with and without the build/16 harness headers: fit-report 'board_area'.

RF._zones_note: computed by srrx_mech.boards.clearance_map (W2 MECH-1, MODEL ESTIMATE): free_mm = free height from the component face (height_zones) or the back face (rear_zones) to the nearest layout envelope, structure part, button-cap flange or shell wall; fits_mm = free_mm - 0.5; max_height stays the envelope limit the model uses for the whole board (layout.board_boxes), so a taller part in a zone needs a per-zone envelope first; mechanical/tests keep these lists equal to the computation (after a layout change: python mechanical/build.py --update-zones)
